preconditions: Captured same-project Git base and current source; explicitly bound current profile paths and trusted optional ModelGate callbacks.
steps: Compare real Git/current artifact and configuration inputs to obtain changed seeds, then execute native validation closure and Core lint.
Change a relation target, a declared dependency or actual SRX profile rule; retain failures outside the directly changed artifact and exact expanded IDs.
Reject missing bases, unbound profiles and unsupported resources; preserve source bytes, native incomplete/failure states and honest empty-scope results.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Option `--changed-only --against <REF>` MUSS Validierung und Linting auf geänderte Artefakte einschließlich der für deren Regeln erforderlichen Abhängigkeiten begrenzen.
oracle.scope: 8.k.W composes captured Git/current sources, changed artifact/configuration seeds, byte-bound current profiles, native validation dependency expansion and Core lint. Incoming/transitive and declared gate dependencies are retained; actual SRX profile edits detect failures in unchanged artifacts. Profile/configuration changes and removals conservatively seed current artifacts; unsupported changed normative resources fail. Native reports, failure policy, exact checked/dependency IDs and raw bindings are retained. No-change/empty-current cases do not fabricate checks. This is loaded-model validation and Core lint only, not full-project, literal/full-lint, live-file, Work or approval coverage.

open_items: Complete R/C hardening and CLI/Work integration; live source freshness, full resource/model semantics, literal/full lint, language-registry binding in this adapter, scalable processing and supported-platform acceptance remain open.
